Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All of the roughly 9,070 games run in your browser and start instantly, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Lots of them are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site is family-friendly only, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Recently played games, favourites and your light or dark choice stay on your device and never leave it, and most games save their own progress the same way. Clearing your browser data or playing in private mode will lose them.
What are the cookie settings about?
If you are in Europe, you are asked before any non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with "Cookie settings" in the footer.
A game will not load. What can I do?
Some games are hosted by their developers, so one can fail on its own. If a game does not start, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com with the game's name and we will look into it.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the Novi Sad studio that runs the site. The rest are licensed from Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, or sent in directly by 14 independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I add it to the site?

Yes. Submitting is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/, and a real person plays every submission. An accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you, while the game stays on your own server.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. You can ask for removal at any time.
Can I put a game on my own website?

You can for the games made by Door 404. Each has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we cannot offer embedding for those.
